summary: Tested new Monthly Recap (Rekap Bulanan) feature end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 new pytest cases pass (admin aggregation with correct grand_total & per-employee labels/sorting, default current month YYYY-MM, empty month returns empty employees list, non-admin scoped to own aggregation only). Frontend: admin dashboard shows MonthlyRecap card with 12-month selector; selecting Juni 2026 renders summary (14 Jam / 4 Karyawan / 4 Total Rekap - includes prior-iteration leftover data), Recharts BarChart displays bars with '4.5j' / '2.5j' labels and karyawan names on X-axis, employee list sorted desc by total_minutes; selecting Januari 2026 shows 'Tidak ada data lembur pada bulan ini.'; employee login correctly hides MonthlyRecap card. Verified Budi Santoso = 4 Jam 30 Menit and E2E Karyawan = 2 Jam 30 Menit for 2026-06.

issues: Transient Recharts warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' during initial container measure (cosmetic, chart still renders correctly)

action_items: (Optional) Suppress Recharts width/height warning by giving ResponsiveContainer parent an explicit min-width/height on first paint
(Optional) Leftover test data from iteration_1 (Budi Test, extra E2E rows) still appears in Juni 2026 recap; not a bug but skews demo totals
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/overtime/monthly-recap uses regex ^YYYY-MM on the date string field which is efficient enough for 5000-doc scan; consider adding a compound index (date, employee_id) if data grows.
Month input is validated only by length==7; malformed values like 'AAAA-BB' fall through to a regex that simply returns no results (safe, but a 400 would be more explicit).
Response includes employee_id derived from stored string; if an employee is later renamed, monthly-recap keeps the historical employee_name from the overtime doc which is correct for audit.
seed_data_creation: Test created & then deleted 2 overtime rows (Budi 2026-06-10 17:00-21:30, E2E 2026-06-11 18:00-20:30) and a temp E2E employee. iteration_1 leftovers (Budi Test employee + prior OT rows) remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Monthly Recap feature (backend + frontend) verified fully working. Values, sorting, empty-state message, and role-based visibility all correct. Selectors: data-testid=monthly-recap, select-recap-month, recap-row-{employee_id}. Month <Select> options use Indonesian locale label (e.g. 'Juni 2026').
